property.name: colon_suffixed_word_stays_string
property.claim: A string that looks like 'Foo:' (a single word followed by a colon, optionally surrounded by whitespace) must not be turned into a dict; it is returned unchanged as the string
property.quote: str argument is mistaken as a dict if it looks like 'Foo:'

findings.relation: new with the fix: before it, this input returns {None: None}

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: The issue reports that the str value 'Foo:' is parsed as {'Foo': None}, and this change makes yaml_load return the string 'Foo:' unchanged, which is exactly that bug fixed.

survivors.original: if isinstance(value, dict) and value and all(v is None for v in value.values()):
survivors.replacement: if isinstance(value, dict) and all(v is None for v in value.values()):
survivors.description: Drops the non-empty check on the dict.
